red_flags.description: Only one OBSERVED evidence signal (MEDIUM confidence, single snapshot) underlies this entire opportunity; no time-series, competitor breakdown, or engagement metrics are available to validate sustained momentum.

The combined hashtag already shows 181.7K posts, indicating the space may already be moderately saturated with similar frequency-abundance content, raising market crowding risk for a differentiated entry.

Any future content claiming that specific frequencies (432Hz/528Hz) 'attract' money, beauty or love as a factual/causal outcome (rather than a subjective or ritual framing) would violate G04/G05 (inventing unproven efficacy/evidence); content must frame this as audience belief/intention-setting, not a proven effect. This is a preventive flag for content production, not a violation found in the current evidence text.

evaluation.summary: This opportunity is grounded in a single MEDIUM-confidence signal showing a Brazilian TikTok creator combining 432Hz+528Hz frequencies for money, beauty and love content, with the associated hashtag reaching 181.7K posts. Asset fit is strong, with matched playlist, page and multiple artists already in the catalog and no new asset required. However, the evidence base is thin (one snapshot, no trend history), competitive saturation is plausible given hashtag volume, and music-DNA fit cannot be fully assessed due to missing catalog detail.
